summary.headline: Finger Inc. acquires 603,483 shares of FG Investment No.2 via debt-to-equity swap for KRW 60.3bn
summary.what_happened: Finger Inc. decided on Nov 26, 2026 to acquire 603,483 new shares of its subsidiary FG Investment No.2 Co., Ltd. through a debt-to-equity conversion (set-off of loans and interest owed to Finger against the share subscription payment), for a total acquisition amount of KRW 60.3bn. After the acquisition, Finger will hold 613,483 shares, equal to 100.00% of FG Investment No.2, with the acquisition scheduled for Nov 26, 2026.

key_numbers.label: Acquisition as % of total assets (latest fiscal year-end)

summary.why_it_matters: Share acquisitions and capital contributions into subsidiaries or other companies are generally disclosed so shareholders can see how a company is allocating capital and restructuring group entities. Debt-to-equity conversions like this one typically change a subsidiary's capital structure without new cash leaving the group, which shareholders may weigh when assessing the group's financial position.
